title: 第4章 记住对她好的，更会记住对她不好的
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
孟静稚脸上的冷笑僵住了。

    她拧着眉，目光死死地盯着眼前顾念念，眼底掠过一丝阴狠。

    “即便如此，那么请问洛师兄，她凭何成为宗主的亲传弟子，凭她是宗主的女儿吗？”

    “若是如此，青云宗数万弟子，他们日以继夜的努力修炼又是为了什么？”

    这话引得那些弟子再次露出了义愤填膺的神色。

    一个废物，凭什么骑在他们头上。

    三长老面露难色，秘密传音于洛靳。

    “洛师兄，如此下去于宗门不利，您看是不是请示一下宗主？”

    洛靳眉头微蹙，眸光冷厉。

    就在这时，一股巨大的威压席卷全场。

    他面色一整，立刻将手贴于顾念念后背之上，顷刻间窒息感如潮水般褪去，顾念念睁开了眼。

    就见上方，女仙人的虚影凌空而立。

    清冷的声音响彻云霄。

    “着新进弟子顾念念入外门杂役院！若一年内能自行修行至炼气期大圆满，便可晋升为外门记名弟子。”

    话落，身影消散。

    全场鸦雀无声。

    孟静稚眸光飞快闪过一抹喜色。

    宗主之女又如何？不还是进了最腌臜的杂役院！

    胆敢抢她的风头，她定叫她知道，什么叫凡人如蝼蚁！生不如死！

    短暂的静默之后，四周再次响起沸沸扬扬的议论。

    “不愧是第一宗门，行事果然坦荡。”

    “宗主之女又如何，没有那修炼资质，也要一视同仁，能入青云宗是我等之幸。”

    “不过，一年修炼到炼气期大圆满，对天才来说轻而易举，对她这个废物来说…无异于白日做梦！”

    “……”

    洛靳面无异色，看着虚无的空中，眼中寒光凛凛。

    顾念念扯了扯他的衣袖，眼神懵懂又天真。

    “我进了杂役院，是不是就不能叫你师兄了？”

    洛靳眼底闪过一抹错愕，随后柔和了眉眼。

    他抬手揉了揉顾念念的小脑袋，温声道：“杂役院隶属外门，按规矩，是不能称呼内门弟子为师兄姐的。”

    见她沮丧了面容，他不由失笑。

    “但你是不是忘了？你是师尊之女，今日宗门大殿之上师尊已经收你为亲传弟子了，便是在外门，在杂役院，你这身份也无法改变。”

    “你依旧是我的小师妹！”

    顾念念猛然抬眼，眼底亮如星辰。

    “那我去杂役院。”

    她举着小拳头，用力地保证。

    “我一定能在一年内到炼气期大圆满的，到时候我就能回去找师兄了。”
content_en:
The sneer on Meng Jingzhi's face froze.

    She frowned, staring intently at Gu Niannian in front of her, with a trace of sinisterness flashing in her eyes.

    "Even so, please ask Senior Brother Luo, why did she become the sect master's direct disciple, and why is she the sect master's daughter?"

    "If this is the case, why do the tens of thousands of disciples of Qingyun Sect work hard day and night to cultivate?"

    These words caused those disciples to show their indignant expressions again.

    Why should a loser sit on their head?

    The third elder looked troubled and secretly sent a message to Luo Jin.

    "Senior Brother Luo, it is not good for the sect to continue like this. Do you think you should ask the sect leader for instructions?"

    Luo Jin frowned slightly, his eyes cold and stern.

    At this moment, a huge pressure swept across the entire place.

    His face straightened, and he immediately put his hand on Gu Niannian's back. In an instant, the suffocation feeling disappeared like a tide, and Gu Niannian opened his eyes.

    Just above, the phantom of the female immortal stood in the sky.

    The cold voice echoed through the sky.

    "The new disciple Gu Niannian will enter the Outer Sect's Miscellaneous Service Courtyard! If he can practice on his own to the Great Perfection of the Qi Refining Period within one year, he can be promoted to a registered disciple of the Outer Sect."

    The words fell and the figure disappeared.

    The whole place was silent.

    Meng Jing's eyes quickly flashed with joy.

    What about the daughter of the patriarch? Why don't we end up in the most disgusting mess hall!

    If you dare to steal her limelight, she will definitely tell her what it means for a mortal to be like an ant! Life is worse than death!

    After a brief silence, heated discussions began all around again.

    "As expected of the first sect, he is indeed magnanimous in his actions."

    "So what if the sect leader's daughter doesn't have the qualifications to practice, but she should be treated equally. We are lucky to be able to join the Qingyun Sect."

    "However, it is easy for a genius to practice to the Qi Refining Stage in one year, but for a loser like her... it is no more than a daydream!"

    "..."

    Luo Jin's face was expressionless, and he looked at the empty sky with a cold light in his eyes.

    Gu Niannian tugged on his sleeves, her eyes confused and innocent.

    "If I enter the handyman's courtyard, can I no longer call you senior brother?"

    A flash of astonishment flashed in Luo Jin's eyes, and then his eyebrows softened.

    He raised his hand and rubbed Gu Niannian's little head, and said warmly: "The Miscellaneous Service Courtyard belongs to the outer sect. According to the rules, inner sect disciples cannot be called senior brothers and sisters."

    Seeing her depressed face, he couldn't help but laugh.

    "But have you forgotten? You are the master's daughter. Today, the master in the sect's main hall has accepted you as his direct disciple. Even in the outer sect and the miscellaneous courtyard, your identity cannot be changed."

    "You are still my little junior sister!"

    Gu Niannian suddenly raised his eyes, his eyes as bright as stars.

    "Then I'll go to the mess hall."

    She raised her little fists and promised forcefully.

    "I will definitely reach the Great Consummation Stage of Qi Refining within a year, and then I can go back to find my senior brother."
title_en: Chapter 4: Remember what is good to her, and remember what is bad to her even more
